<function name="GetIndentSize" parent="DTree" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns the indentation size of the <page>DTree</page>, the distance between each "level" of the tree is offset on the left from the previous level.

Currently this feature has no effect on the <page>DTree</page> element.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The indentation size.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
